name: opencode-session-hub
description: Browse every OpenCode session on your machine and keep them synced across workstations via a private Git repository.

opencodeSessionHub.storagePath.description: Override the OpenCode global storage directory. Leave empty to auto-detect (~/.local/share/opencode on Linux/macOS, %LOCALAPPDATA%\opencode on Windows).

opencodeSessionHub.syncRepoPath.description: Local path used to mirror the sync repository. Leave empty to use the extension's global storage folder.

opencodeSessionHub.syncRemoteUrl.description: Git remote URL of the private sync repository (e.g. git@github.com:you/my-opencode-sync.git).

opencodeSessionHub.autoSyncOnFocusLost.description: Automatically push session state when the VS Code window loses focus (debounced).

opencodeSessionHub.autoPullOnStartup.description: Automatically pull the latest session state when VS Code starts.

opencodeSessionHub.debounceSeconds.description: Seconds of inactivity to wait before auto-pushing changes.

opencodeSessionHub.redactSecrets.description: Strip API keys, tokens and other credential-shaped strings from session data before syncing.
